Specification: This specification is a very small test module intended to exercise annotation handling in comments rather than model a complex algorithm. It declares a single state variable S, initializes it to the empty set, and defines one next-state action that updates S to the singleton set {1}. It also defines a simple invariant stating that 2 is not an element of S, and includes several comment annotations for type aliases and unit-test style metadata.
